name: Choose Powers and Fight 💥
desc:
💥 Grind to unlock new and unique Powers and PVP other players.
🤔 Edit your equipped Abilities in inventory to choose your own custom Power Set.

⚠️ We are constantly looking for ways to improve the game, any feedback on how we can improve the game is appreciated.

CONTROLS:
PUNCH - Left Click/Tap UI Button
BLOCK - Hold F/UI Button
ABILITY - 1-4/Tap UI Button
EMOTE - R/Tap UI Button 

🏷️ Tags: Fighting, Powers, Super Hero, Super Power, Cash, Blade Ball, Strongest Battlegrounds, Battlegrounds, Heroes, RNG, Jujitsu, Battle, Magic, Ability.
